crossRefs.note: Timothy, my fellow worker, greets you, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my relatives.
I commend to you Phoebe, our sister, who is a servant of the assembly that is at Cenchreae,
For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision amounts to anything, nor uncircumcision, but faith working through love.
Peace be to the brothers, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
but the goal of this command is love, out of a pure heart and a good conscience and sincere faith,
hearing of your love and of the faith which you have toward the Lord Jesus, and toward all the saints,
The elder, to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth, and not I only, but also all those who know the…
for the truth’s sake, which remains in us, and it will be with us forever:
The elder to Gaius the beloved, whom I love in truth.
The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
Grace be with all those who love our Lord Jesus Christ with incorruptible love. Amen.
The Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.
Grace be with you all. Amen.

translations.web: All who are with me greet you. Greet those who love us in faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.
translations.bsb: All who are with me send you greetings. Greet those who love us in the faith. Grace be with all of you.
translations.kjv: All that are with me salute thee. Greet them that love us in the faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.
translations.asv: All that are with me salute thee. Salute them that love us in faith. Grace be with you all.
